needs.source: Advanced Monolithic Systems AMS1117 data sheet (DS1117, no revision printed; PDF of 2009-08-27), p. 4 'Stability': the output capacitor is part of the frequency compensation; 22 µF solid tantalum on the output ensures stability for all operating conditions – entered as the minimum (smaller values are allowed without an ADJ bypass, no value given)

4.name: VOUT
4.hint: the tab: output, the same node as pin 2 (p. 1 'tab is output')

hints: dropout 1.1 V typ, 1.3 V max at 0.8 A, higher above 0.8 A (p. 3, note 4) – from a 5 V rail the output stays at 3.3 V only while VIN − VOUT covers it
output capacitor is part of the loop compensation: 22 µF solid tantalum is stable in all conditions (p. 4); no ESR window and no statement on ceramic capacitors
thermal shutdown above 165 °C (p. 4); θJA 46 … > 90 K/W depending on the copper area at the tab (p. 2, table 1 p. 5)

compliance.source: AMS1117 data sheet p. 1: 'RoHs Compliant'; LCSC product data C6186 (2026-10-31): RoHS certificate listed (isRohsCert, ROHS)

sources: Advanced Monolithic Systems AMS1117 data sheet (DS1117, no revision printed; PDF of 2009-08-27), via LCSC https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/e6935943fc6b1bbf350a1a0f3e90dc4a.pdf?productCode=C6186, read 2026-10-31; the manufacturer's site advanced-monolithic.com did not resolve
pins: p. 1 'pin connections', SOT-223 top view 1 ground/adjust, 2 VOUT, 3 VIN, tab is output – the EasyEDA symbol of C6186 (edakit part import 2026-10-31): 1 GND, 2 VOUT, 3 VIN, 4 VOUT
vdd_max_v 15 and VIN v_max_v 15: p. 2 absolute maximum ratings, input voltage 15 V
tj_max_c 125, t_min_c -40: p. 2 operating junction temperature range -40 … 125 °C (control section and power transistor); p. 5 'maximum junction temperature must not exceed 125 °C'
rth_ja_k_per_w 90: p. 2 SOT-223 θJA 90 °C/W with package soldered to copper, 46 to > 90 °C/W depending on mounting and copper area; table 1 p. 5: 55 … 80 °C/W; θJC 15 °C/W (p. 3)
vout_v 3.3: p. 2 AMS1117-3.3 output voltage 3.251 / 3.300 / 3.349 V at VIN 4.8 V, 3.201 … 3.399 V over the full temperature range
dropout_v 1.3: p. 3 dropout voltage at IOUT 0.8 A, typ 1.1 V, max 1.3 V (note 4: higher above 0.8 A) – the maximum entered, the ldo model takes one value
iq_a 0.011: p. 3 quiescent current of the fixed versions at VIN − VOUT = 1.5 V, typ 5 mA, max 11 mA – the maximum entered

i_out_max_a 0.8: p. 1 'output current of 1 A'; p. 3 current limit 0.9 / 1.1 / 1.5 A (min / typ / max) at VIN − VOUT = 1.5 V; dropout, line and load regulation are specified up to 0.8 A – 0.8 A entered, the load the specification covers
p. 3 note 2: line and load regulation guaranteed up to 1.2 W dissipation in SOT-223; power dissipation 'internally limited' (p. 2) – no p_max_w entered
LCSC product data C6186 (2026-10-31): Advanced Monolithic Systems AMS1117-3.3, 1 292 700 pcs; JLCPCB catalogue (edakit part search, 2026-10-31): Basic Part, 1 780 024 pcs
notes: Fixed 3.3 V LDO, 1 A class, behaviour model ldo (pins vin, vout, gnd). Library draft, group power.

verified.datasheet: Advanced Monolithic Systems AMS1117 data sheet (DS1117, no revision printed; PDF of 2009-08-27)
checked: SOT-223 pinout p. 1 (1 GND/ADJ, 2 VOUT, 3 VIN, tab VOUT) = EasyEDA symbol of C6186 (1 GND, 2 VOUT, 3 VIN, 4 VOUT)
absolute maximum p. 2: input voltage 15 V, junction -40 … 125 °C, θJA SOT-223 90 °C/W
electrical characteristics p. 2–3: VOUT 3.3 V (3.201 … 3.399 V), dropout 1.1 / 1.3 V at 0.8 A, quiescent 5 / 11 mA, current limit 0.9 / 1.1 / 1.5 A
application hints p. 4: 22 µF solid tantalum output capacitor for stability in all conditions; thermal shutdown 165 °C
open: no revision number in the document; the manufacturer's site did not resolve – the LCSC copy (PDF of 2009-08-27) was read

no operating input range and no undervoltage lockout: vin_min_v left out, so edakit's coverage lists the AMS1117 under LIM.range ('no vin_min_v'); the regulation limit is VOUT + dropout, which the ldo model already applies
output capacitor: 22 µF solid tantalum is the only value; no ESR window, no statement on ceramic capacitors
no input capacitor in the data sheet (the default decoupling of a power_in pin still asks for one)
minimum load 5 / 10 mA is specified for the adjustable AMS1117 only; none for the -3.3
LCSC's RoHS certificate for C6186 carries a file name of another company (Mysentech) – the certificate itself was not read
